scientific_decisions.reason: POWO/WCVP accepts species in Poaceae at species rank; first published Bull. Torrey Bot. Club 11:61 (1884). Canonical learner species-level name remains valid.
POWO/WCVP accepts autonym subspecies; separate accepted infraspecific concept from subsp. filipes.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Panicum hallii subsp. filipes (Scribn.) Freckmann & Lelong
scientific_decisions.accepted_target: Panicum hallii subsp. filipes (Scribn.) Freckmann & Lelong
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO/WCVP accepts subspecies, combination published Sida 20:172 (2002), supported by Zuloaga & Aliscioni 2023 Panicum monograph.

scientific_decisions.accepted_target: Panicum hallii subsp. filipes (Scribn.) Freckmann & Lelong
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO homotypic synonym of accepted subsp. filipes, original species-rank name published 1895. Historical Panicum filipes labels are not a second learner species solely by nomenclature.

scientific_decisions.accepted_target: Panicum hallii subsp. filipes (Scribn.) Freckmann & Lelong
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO homotypic synonym of accepted subsp. filipes; variety combination published 1974. Do not treat different rank spelling as a second species.
POWO places historical P. virletii as a heterotypic synonym of subsp. hallii, NOT of subsp. filipes.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Panicum hallii var. filipes vs subsp. filipes
scientific_decisions.reason: ITIS TSN 529363 accepts variety rank and treats subspecies as a synonym, whereas POWO/WCVP accepts subspecies and synonymizes variety. Preserve authority-labelled rank concepts; do not assert all backbones agree.

scientific_decisions.source_name: historical broad Panicum hallii records without subspecies diagnostic evidence
scientific_decisions.reason: 2006 World Grass Species synonymy cited by POWO used broader species treatment; 2023 Zuloaga & Aliscioni recognizes two subspecies. Historic undifferentiated species-level observations cannot be assigned automatically to either subspecies.
Both accepted POWO subspecies are nested within accepted P. hallii; the existing species-level card remains nomenclaturally valid without splitting or renaming pending subspecies-specific evidence.

scientific_decisions.source_name: individual photographs and observations of existing Panicum hallii learner
scientific_decisions.reason: No independent voucher-level determination to subsp. hallii or subsp. filipes was performed. Name acceptance cannot validate individual photographed plants or justify subspecies-level photo labels.

scientific_decisions.source_name: individual hybrid identity for Panicum hallii observations
scientific_decisions.reason: No verified hybrid parentage or hybrid specimen evidence was evaluated. Preserve existing identity/hybrid holds and do not infer ancestry from subspecies rank or silhouette.

scientific_decisions.source_name: claim that POWO/WCVP accepts Panicum hallii var. filipes at variety rank
scientific_decisions.accepted_target: Panicum hallii subsp. filipes (Scribn.) Freckmann & Lelong
scientific_decisions.reason: Rejected under POWO: the variety is explicitly a synonym of the accepted subspecies. This FAIL is specific to the proposed POWO variety-rank assertion, NOT to the taxon or to ITIS's alternative accepted variety concept.

backbone.primary_revision: Zuloaga, F. & Aliscioni, S. (2023). Panicum (Poaceae). Flora Neotropica, Monograph 124: 1–292 (as cited by POWO).

alternative_authority.treatment: ITIS accepts Panicum hallii var. filipes rather than POWO's accepted subsp. filipes; historical alternative, not a specimen determination.

handoff.manual_followup: Retain one species-level Panicum hallii learner entry. For any proposed subspecies-level photo ID, examine voucher and diagnostic evidence under chosen backbone; preserve original labels and the POWO vs ITIS rank disagreement.
